verses.text: When you enter the land the LORD your God is giving you as your inheritance, take possession of it, and settle there,
take some of the first produce you harvest from the land the LORD your God is giving you. Put it in a basket and go to the place the LORD your God chooses for his name to dwell.
Go to the priest serving at that time and tell him, “Today I declare to the LORD your God that I've come into the land the LORD swore to our ancestors he would give us.”
The priest is to take the basket from your hand and set it down in front of the altar of the LORD your God.

Then say in the presence of the LORD your God, “My ancestor was a Syrian on the verge of dying. He went down to Egypt and lived there with only a few people. There his family grew into a great, powerful nation with many people.
The Egyptians mistreated us, made us suffer, and forced us to do hard labor.
Then we cried out to the LORD, the God of our ancestors. The LORD heard us and saw how we were suffering, how hard we were working, and how badly we were oppressed.
The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, with terrifying acts, signs, and wonders.
He brought us here and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
And now I've brought the first produce from the land you gave me, LORD.” Set it down before the LORD your God and worship there in his presence.
Celebrate all the good things the LORD your God has given you and your household. Include the Levites and the foreigners living among you in the celebration.

The third year is the year of the tithe. When you've finished setting aside a tenth of all you produced that year, give it to the Levites, the foreigners, the fatherless, and the widows, so they can eat their fill in your towns.

Then say in the presence of the LORD your God, “I've taken what was set apart for you out of my house and given it to the Levites, the foreigners, the fatherless, and the widows, just as you commanded me. I haven't broken or forgotten any of your commands.
I haven't eaten any of it while I was mourning, taken any of it out while I was unclean, or given any of it for the dead. I've listened to the LORD my God and done everything you commanded me.
Look down from your holy home in heaven and bless your people Israel and the land you've given us, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as you swore to our ancestors.”
Today the LORD your God commands you to follow these laws and rulings. Keep them and live by them with all your heart and all your soul.
Today you've declared that the LORD is your God. You've committed to following his ways, keeping his laws, commands, and rulings, and listening to his voice.
Today the LORD has declared that you are his own people, just as he promised you, and that you are to keep all his commands.
He will set you high above every nation he has made and give you praise, a good name, and honor. You will be a people set apart for the LORD your God, just as he said.
